The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), and the Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the CEQA pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 31.04(h)

items.title: Authorize the issuance of (1) up to $506,000,000 of Wastewater Revenue Bonds, 2026 Series A

items.title: Update and discussion on the status of the selection process for a new General Manager
items.text: Update and discussion on the status of the selection process for a new General Manager. (Discussion Only) Vice President Leveroni provided a brief summary of Agenda Item 7 from the July 14, 2026 SFPUC Meeting relating to the selection process for a new General Manager (GM) through the San Francisco Department of Human Services (DHR); announced Commissioner Stacy as the Commission’s point of contact and liaison to DHR to support efficiency; and, stated Commissioner Stacy will report the GM search process and status to the Commission after its return from recess in September 2026. Shawn Sherburne, Department of Human Resources Employment Services Assistant Director, reported on the status of the GM search and stated the expectation is to have a search firm identified by August 11, 2026. Commissioner Jamdar thanked Commissioner Stacy for her willingness to serve as the Commission liaison to DHR and stated she is fine with eliminating the idea of having a special meeting in August 2026 to finalize the GM search now that Commissioner Stacy is the liaison for the Commission. Commissioner Stacy thanked the Commission for its confidence in her and stated that she is happy to be involved, will do what is necessary, and desires a transparent and inclusive GM search process
